objective: Implement a typed transform/crop effect with preview/export parity
flags: Effect writes on; YAMAKAN_EFFECTS_OFF=1 refuses new effect values (command, batch, save) while stored effects keep rendering
deviations: Transform v1 has scale, offset and crop; rotation is not included
The interactive canvas draws scale and position exactly; it does not draw a crop (the reference preview and export do, and the preview-parity notice names it as effectCrop)
Projects with effects are canonical v6, which an earlier build refuses as a newer format; projects without effects keep their v4/v5 bytes
The scaled-pixel budget (1920x1080x16) and the 20-pixel crop minimum are checked when a plan is compiled (preview or export), not when the value is set
Undo, redo and restore move between stored revisions with the off switch on (documented)
core/render.ts is donor-derived; its change is recorded in imports.json

tests.result: 8 effect tests: export and reference preview match golden regions for crop, scale 0.5 and scale with offset on a two-colour still, and for footage scaled 2x past the frame with a negative offset and 0.5 opacity; an identity transform leaves the plan hash and decoded frame unchanged; persist, undo, redo and reopen; NaN, Infinity, huge or fractional scale, filter/ASS injection strings, version 2, unknown kinds, paths, over-crop, two transforms, an empty stack and an effect on a title are refused; a stored unknown effect is refused, never dropped; the off switch holds and stored effects still render; a tiny source refuses a crop; canonical v6, the editor diff, split, a refused move to an audio track, OTIO round trip and forgery, and the parity notice. Edge E2E: the Transform control commits on Enter, undoes, redoes and saves as the versioned effect, and the live canvas matches the reference render with the half-size transform
